data.name: Omen(One Man's Eternal Night)
data.detailed_description:
PLAY THE PUBLIC BETA NOW

Omen: One Man’s Eternal Night is currently in an active public beta phase. To see the stunning official cover artwork by fantasy legend Richard Hescox and jump into the carnage immediately, download the Zoltan platform.

Click the "Visit Website" link in the sidebar on the right to access the V0.05 Beta right now.

data.short_description: One Man’s Eternal Night is a savage 3D action-adventure where you become Omen, a fallen prince betrayed by love, cursed by Hell, and reborn as the first and only Velmorr a monstrous, living weapon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit / SteamOS (Holoiso)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 (Integrated)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: NO
  • Additional Notes: NA

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 9000 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Torture. Gore. Betrayal. This is a world of demons, death, and twisted love. You’re not here to save the world. You’re here to make it bleed for what it did to you.
